_comment: Reference ground truth for test.mp4 — entities visually confirmed in the screencast (Google Account / Password Manager of 'Pet Lysenko'). Used by test_benchmark.py to measure how much castreaper actually surfaces. Add items as new ones are confirmed; keep only entities a human verified in the frames.

emails.description: High-value OSINT emails. Both appear ~second 57-100 of the clip.

domains.description: Domains/URLs visibly present (address bar, password manager list, speed-dial).

urls.description: Full path-bearing URLs. An item may be {value, match}: 'value' is the real URL as seen in the frame, 'match' is an OCR-stable substring used for scoring (the random token in a password-reveal link is not reliably recognised, so we match on the stable prefix).

stretch.description: Not scored against the baseline (weight 0). Future-capability targets: phone numbers, person names, passwords. Track these once the tool learns to extract them.
